# Field boundaries for France - Eurocrops 2018

France - Eurocrops 2018 field boundaries (2018) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Institut National de l'Information Géographique et Forestière <https://geoservices.ign.fr/rpg>, EuroCrops. License: CC-BY-SA-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_fr/latest/ec_fr.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_fr/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2154; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: metrics:area, id, hcat:name_en, group_code, crop:code, hcat:name, hcat:code, geometry, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_fr/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_fr/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ec_fr/collection.json
